subtitle: Teach your assistant, one memory at a time
description: Type a note, tap Remember, and your device's assistant stores it. The list comes from the assistant's memory via octos.session.history; nothing is kept on the device. Without an assistant service the app shows 'Assistant unavailable' and does nothing else. The writer half of a Notes + Digest pair that share one assistant memory.
release_notes: Second version: no local cache. The assistant is the source of truth; 'Assistant unavailable' is the only state on devices without an octos service (today: every OctoSense shell, every card-host).
